name: roqam
description: ROQAM (Readout & Quick Access Mod): a status bar for Claude Code (terminal and desktop app, Windows) with English or German labels.

plugins.name: roqam
plugins.description: Status bar above the prompt: context, plan limits, prompt-cache countdown, Anthropic status, model, version, chats, connectors, one-click buttons, recording mode, and tonight's sky and weather at your location. Windows; labels in English.
